context: Tests predicate capture rules, supported expressions, targeted indexing, and evidence-based migration guidance.

checklist.name: Captured clock
checklist.description: Captures the current time in a local value before constructing the #Predicate instead of evaluating Date.now directly inside it.

checklist.name: Supported predicate
checklist.description: Removes arbitrary model helper calls from #Predicate and uses supported stored-property expressions or post-fetch filtering when necessary.

checklist.name: Targeted indexes
checklist.description: Indexes only properties used frequently for filtering or sorting rather than indexing every property.

checklist.name: Compound index
checklist.description: Considers a compound index for a repeatedly used filter-and-sort property combination.

checklist.name: Migration evidence
checklist.description: Does not guarantee that index changes are migration-free and requires schema or migration testing.

checklist.name: Query profiling
checklist.description: Uses profiling, Instruments, or Core Data diagnostics to verify the query and index effect.
